Name: Growable Wood
Author: ChillsEmporium
Description:
[b]Growable Wood – Stardew Valley Mod Description[/b][b]:[/b]
This mod allows players to grow wood mod quicker and easier to get trather than a tree as a crop in [i]Stardew Valley[/i]. You can purchase stone seeds from Pierre’s General Store. Once planted, they take [b]4 days[/b] to fully grow.[line][b]Planned Features[/b][list]
[*]Add availability to [b]JojaMart[/b] for late-game progression (pending investigation).
[*]Continue developing and refining [b]artwork[/b] for the stone plant.
[/list][line][b]Installation Instructions[/b][list=1]
[*][b]Download and Extract[/b]
After downloading the mod, extract the contents.
[*][b]Move the Mod Folder[/b]
Place the folder named [b]Growable Stone[/b] into:
[code]Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods
[/code]
[*][b]Install Required Dependencies[/b]
This mod requires the following:[list]
[*]SMAPI – The mod loader for Stardew Valley.
[*]JSON Assets – Required for adding custom items and crops.
[*]SpaceCore – A core library used by many mods.
[/list]To install [b]Json Assets[/b] and [b]SpaceCore[/b], extract each mod and move their folders to the same [code] locationMods[/code] folder as above.
For [b]SMAPI[/b], follow the included installer instructions for your version of the game. A [b]video tutorial[/b] will be provided soon to assist with installation.
[/list][line][b]Uninstall[/b] the mod, simply delete the [b]Growable Stone[/b] folder from your [code]Mods[/code] directory.[line][b]Bug Reports & Balancing[/b] you encounter any bugs or have suggestions for balancing or improvements, please reach out. Your feedback is very much appreciated.[line][b]Want to Help? [/b]If you're an [b]artist[/b] or [b]coder[/b] and would like to collaborate on this or future mods, feel free to contact me! I'm planning to release many more mods in the future.[line][b]Requirements[/b][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[/list][list]
[/list][line][b]Tools Used[/b][list]
[*]Visual Studio 2022
[*]GIMP
[/list][line][b]Credits[/b][list]
[*][b]Markchill[/b] – Mod concept, coding, and stone plant artwork
[*][b]ErosDkAi[/b] – Original seed sprite from the [i]Growable Ore[/i] mod, generously shared for this project
[/list][line][b]Support the Mod[/b]If you enjoy this mod, please consider supporting the development. Donations are welcome and help make future content possible.
